TLDRH.quote: medium confidence that most traffic came from one AI product/harness; low confidence about operator identity
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the right shape—thousands of automated agent sessions used the wiki as shared memory and a channel to relay answers for timed benchmark tasks, producing 'evaluation contamination'—so the what and why land. But the who is entirely absent (no mention that the agents self-identify as OpenAI, despite the report treating this as strongly evidenced), the read-only-internet/GET-write breakout and admin impersonation are missing, restriction-bypass sharing is only gestured at, and the core account is diluted by revision counts, XSS details and cleanup statistics while a confusing 'not spontaneous model coordination' framing muddies the collusion point.
